steps.code:
# Now I have the access token. Let me get all downloaded songs first. I'll need to handle pagination.
access_token = login_result["access_token"]
downloaded_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_downloaded_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    downloaded_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total downloaded songs: {len(downloaded_songs)}")
downloaded_song_ids = set(song["song_id"] for song in downloaded_songs)
print(downloaded_song_ids)

    print(f"Skipped to next song: {next_result}")
    current_song = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    current_song_id = current_song["song_id"]
    print(f"Current song ID: {current_song_id}, Title: {current_song['title']}, Is downloaded: {current_song_id in downloaded_song_ids}")

print(f"\nReached downloaded song: {current_song['title']} (ID: {current_song_id})")
